instruction: Cinematic film still, low-angle full shot. In a classical dance studio with wooden floors, the brunette ballerina (R1) in a white leotard and sheer skirt stands in the foreground left, posing en pointe on her left foot while holding the wooden barre. In the background right, the blonde ballerina (R2) in a white leotard and sheer skirt stands en pointe with her arms extended. Both dancers maintain elegant, upright postures. Soft natural light filters through a large window, illuminating the neutral-toned room and casting gentle shadows on the floor.
